handling_notes: ZIP archive: read pinned members in memory only (dbs external); never extract. 6 __MACOSX AppleDouble entries are excluded. No timestamps (rows paired by index within SessionID 1-5); units, coordinate frames, anchor geometry and tag/marker reference points are undeclared; README sample counts include the header row. UWB vs OptiTrack comparability is established in 0/10 sessions (RES-721 report): integer row lag non-zero in 7/10 (Walk 1,0,0,1,0; Trolley 3,3,3,3,3), lag-aligned similarity frame fails in 10/10 (Walk translation 0.27-0.30; Trolley scale 0.968-0.975, rotation up to 3.3 deg), motion-dependent residual in 9/10 (Trolley cross-track +0.027..+0.045 = mounting offset; Walk along-track -0.028..-0.037 = fractional lag or mounting offset, not separable). Walk: 4 negative-range sentinels and impossibly short ranges at anchors 1 and 3; Trolley anchor geometry inconsistent (h^2 < 0). No UWB error metric may be reported; OptiTrack is not ground truth.
privacy_notes: Testbed radio-localisation data from Toshiba Research Europe: tag positions, ranges and radio features (CIR, PSA, AoA, RSSI). The 'walking' scenario is non-identifiable human locomotion (a tag carried by an unidentified person; consent undocumented, judged not applicable because no personal data exist); 'trolley' has a tag on a trolley. No names, IDs, demographics, biometrics, dates or images.
